semantics.function: sel 0 through 8 selects a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i respectively; sel 9 through 15 produces 16 bits of one
semantics.timing: Purely combinational; output responds to current inputs without a clock cycle or storage
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization required

numeric.arithmetic: None; selected vector copied bit for bit

verification.oracle: Independent array indexed by known selector; selectors >=9 expect 0xffff
coverage: All 16 selector values with distinct input patterns
Walking-one and walking-zero data bits on every selected port
Deterministic pseudorandom vectors for every selector
Input changes with selector held constant to detect stale outputs
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts

specification_ambiguities: X/Z selector behavior is unspecified by the original problem; no verification requirement is imposed for unknown selectors.
